text_en: Gods above, I'm gonna have a heart attack!
You've managed to find all the parts!
Incredible, just incredible! I can't wait to analyse them.
Oh... I hope you haven't had trouble with the Croma. I wouldn't want to get on the wrong side of one of them.
What would my reputation be if I didn't keep my promises? Here, my latest explosive model.
Use it carefully. It sticks to surfaces and can be detonated from afar. I hope it doesn't get stuck to your hands when you try to throw it.
